subject: Private deployment: ask on capacity estimates + governance playbook
messages:

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment feasibility questions and timeline

Hi Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our leadership liked the latency/cost numbers, but two asks came out of our security & infra review:

1) Can you confirm a realistic GPU footprint for a 10k daily active-user production pilot (rough batch mix attached in the SOW)?
2) We need a short governance playbook for VPC + on-prem installers: what RBAC/audit controls are available out of the box, and what requires custom configs or managed services?

We're on a tight procurement window and need a resource estimate (FTEs + timeline) for an air-gapped pilot. Also looping in our legal for standard data residency language.

Attached: initial-sow.pdf (high-level traffic profile)

Can Marcus or the infra team share an initial read on the sizing assumptions and whether we should plan for an on-prem gateway + dedicated GPUs?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Infrastructure, Greenfield Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility questions and timeline

Tom — thanks for the note and the SOW. High level reply below and next steps.

TL;DR: we can support a 10k DAU pilot but the exact GPU footprint depends on model family, quantization, and your target p99 latency. For an air-gapped pilot we'll need a dedicated scoping window (2–3 weeks) to validate network, storage, and KMS integration.

Quick answers:
- Sizing: ballpark 4x A100-40G equiv for a mixed-generation LLM pilot (conservative); with q4/8 quant it could drop to 2–3 GPUs with some latency tradeoffs.
- Governance & audit: built-in token-level logging, per-route RBAC, KMS integrations supported (we'll need customer-managed keys for air-gap). Some features (console-hosted tracing UI) require a separate collector when offline.
- Ops staffing: for pilot we recommend 0.5 FTE SRE (deployment support) + 0.5 FTE infra eng (network/KMS) for 8 weeks; for production add 1 FTE oncall + support rotation.

Requested next steps:
1) Marcus/Rishi: run a quick technical read against the SOW and the attached vpc-customer-checklist.xlsx — highlight any blockers (network, storage, image signing).
2) Laura: sanity-check resourcing ask and provide an escalation path if we need an exceptions approval (lead time for hiring/contracting).
3) Tom: can you share your preferred window for a 30-min architecture sync next week?

I'll upload a draft "deployment playbook" (redwood-deployment-playbook-draft.docx) to Confluence after we align.

Best,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 13:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility questions and timeline

Quick technical read — copying the checklist items I pulled out:

1) Network: we need IP allowlist + NAT egress for metrics/tracing collectors. If fully air-gapped, we'll bring our metrics exporter as a binary (we'll need a signed image and an offline installer).

2) Storage: model shards + KV cache require ~6TB SSD per A100 equivalent for a mixed retrieval/LLM profile. If they want persistent cache across restarts, add replication plan.

3) Security/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own key). For HSM-backed signing of images we need CloudOps partner to provide signing PKI (see CloudOps reply).

4) Runtime constraints: if they insist on p99 < 150ms we probably need a larger cluster and pinned model variants; quantization helps but will change output distribution (needs QA).

Notes for the sync:
- I'll prepare a short slide with the GPU/hour cost delta across options (A100x4 vs A100x2+quant).
- Can the customer confirm target p50/p95/p99 and typical prompt length? That will materially change the recommendation.

On the governance playbook: I added a short Confluence draft here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Private+Deploy+Checklist — it lists required artifacts (signed installer, KMS proof, audit log retention).

Marcus
Senior Systems Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
